$comment: Settings for scripts/jev/gate.mjs; see 'CI gate' in scripts/jev/README.md. mode 'report' never fails the job (the summary says what WOULD block); 'block' fails it on any block not accepted in gate-baseline.json. Thresholds are Jev's probability that the app's claim holds: below block_below blocks, below warn_below warns, anything higher is agreement. max_usd caps a normal (changes-only) run; max_usd_full caps the weekly --full run.
